name: Statens Museum for Kunst
notes: SMK, the National Gallery of Denmark: Vilhelm Dahlerup and G. E. W. Møller's Neo-Renaissance building (1889–96) facing Sølvgade, red brick on a stone base with stone string course and cornice, a higher central pavilion with its stone-framed portal, end pavilions, slate roofs (the hips drawn as stepped rows so they can stand on the building's real bearing, about 25° off the grid); behind it the glass Sculpture Street and Anna Maria Indrio's white modern wing (1998) looking onto Østre Anlæg's lake and trees. Materials and dates from SMK and press descriptions; the plan's bearing from the streets in the OpenStreetMap ground; all dimensions, the roof forms and the window rhythm are guessed. No photographs were available.
